title: CERC Waives Transmission Charges For Delayed 50 MW Hybrid Project
case_name: AMPIN Energy Green Private Limited and AMPIN Energy Green Three Private Limited
card_summary: CERC granted AMPIN Energy Green's 50 MW wind-solar hybrid project a full waiver of interstate transmission system charges, departing from the phase-out that applies to projects commissioned after June 2025. The Commission found the delay was caused by the Fatehgarh-IV ISTS pooling station not being ready, not by any default of the developer, and extended the project's commissioning deadline on that basis.
card_tip: Where commissioning slips because the ISTS pooling station is not ready, press CERC for the older, cheaper transmission-charge waiver instead of accepting the post-June 2025 regime by default.
verification_notes: Reported independently by Mercom India and SolarQuarter, both naming Petition No. 228/MP/2026, the AMPIN Energy Green entities, the Fatehgarh-IV pooling station basis for the waiver, and the revised SCOD. Decision date taken from both outlets' reporting window (around 20-21 October 2026); the CERC order itself was not separately accessed.
